caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a vertical, cylindrical post with a spiraling band or strip wrapped around it. At the top of the post, the band ends in a hooked form projecting outward. About midway down the post, a small loop protrudes from the spiral. The post is anchored on a wide, rounded base with smooth contours that flares outward, providing stability. The entire object is rendered in grayscale, giving it a metallic appearance with areas of shading to indicate light and shadow. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned. In the bottom left corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads "Charles Garjian."
title: Candlestick
